logp.method_description: The hydrophobicity (logP) of the series of compounds was determined using the shake-flask method. Aqueous (0.15 M KCl in MilliQ water, 100 mL) and organic (n-octanol, 100 mL) phases were mixed together for 72 h to allow saturation of both phases. The Pt compounds (ca. 1 mg) were dissolved in the aqueous phase (1.0 mL) at a final concentration of ca. 2 mM and an equal volume of saturated n-octanol was added. The two phases were mixed for 30 min using a magnetic stirrer set at 600 rpm. Samples were centrifuged (1500 g, 10 min) to separate the two phases and the platinum contents of the organic and aqueous phases were determined by ICP-MS. The value of logPo/w was calculated as the logarithm of the ratio between the Pt concentration in the organic phase and the aqueous phase.
